title: Prepare the portfolio
WHERE: Before the seminar, your own project folder
WHAT: Your earlier work and current witnesses
EXACT ACTION: Bring your P01 work and a redacted evidence inventory for the project you will review. If unfinished, list the missing work.
EXPECTED: A named project, version and evidence locators, or an honest incomplete state.
GATE: Do not assume a historical PASS is current.
RECOVERY: Keep the original evidence and mark its date and scope.
STOP: Do not claim completion without a witness.

title: Extract the kit
EXACT ACTION: Save the Student ZIP and its SHA-256 sidecar. Use Extract All on Windows or your archive utility on macOS/Linux into a fresh writable folder. Open the extracted root, not the ZIP viewer.
EXPECTED: Root contains KIT_CONFIG.json, tools, projects and the OPEN_BEGINNER_GUIDE launchers.
RECORD: Source version and ZIP SHA from the trusted sidecar.
GATE: Use the Student kit only. Teacher archives contain answers and private marking.
RECOVERY: Re-extract into a new folder if files are missing.
STOP: Do not modify a manifest to force PASS.
NEXT: Open this guide from the extracted folder.

title: Open the extracted root in VS Code
EXACT ACTION: Use File > Open Folder and select the extracted root. Inspect the source before accepting Workspace Trust under your institution policy. Do not bypass Restricted Mode blindly.
EXPECTED: Explorer shows tools and projects/p01/student.
RECORD: Folder identity without unnecessary absolute personal path.
GATE: The terminal must belong to this root.
RECOVERY: Close the wrong workspace and open the correct folder.
STOP: Do not run commands inside the ZIP.

title: Open a root terminal
WHERE: VS Code in the extracted kit
EXACT ACTION: Use Terminal > New Terminal. The launcher commands below assume the extracted root. On Windows choose Command Prompt for the CMD route; PowerShell can run .\VERIFY_PACKAGE.cmd too.
EXPECTED: You can see KIT_CONFIG.json in the root Explorer.
GATE: Use the platform route printed below.
RECOVERY: Navigate through Open Folder instead of guessing a long cd command.
STOP: Stop if the terminal belongs to another project.

title: Verify the untouched package
EXACT ACTION:
Windows: .\VERIFY_PACKAGE.cmd
macOS/Linux: sh ./VERIFY_PACKAGE.sh
EXPECTED: ok true and mode EXACT_INITIAL_PACKAGE with packageId.
GATE: Exact files and bytes, including the editable starter, must match initially.
RECOVERY: Keep the error and re-extract from the trusted ZIP.
STOP: Extra files, links or changed files stop the route. Save logs and PDFs outside the kit.

title: Check the exact environment
EXACT ACTION:
Windows: .\CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.cmd
macOS/Linux: sh ./CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.sh
EXPECTED: Node v24.21.0 and npm 11.19.0 with ok true.
GATE: No public override and no installer is run.
RECOVERY: Ask the teaching support route for the prescribed environment; retain mismatch as evidence.
STOP: A mismatch blocks technical execution. You may inspect sources and label SOURCE_ANALYSIS.

title: Write two prospective predictions
EXACT ACTION: Predict which assertion detects missing persistence despite a successful create response. Predict whether a green build without start/health/shutdown can support runtime-health PASS. State what would falsify each prediction.
EXPECTED: Two written predictions before the relevant experiments.
GATE: Do not copy a model answer as an observation.
RECOVERY: Use narrower claims with an observable difference.
STOP: Stop if the prediction cannot be falsified.

title: Verify the initial state
EXACT ACTION:
Windows: .\VERIFY_INITIAL_STATE.cmd
macOS/Linux: sh ./VERIFY_INITIAL_STATE.sh
EXPECTED: P01 baseline 2 pass, objective 5 tests with 4 expected ERR_ASSERTION failures and 1 cleanup pass, regression 3 pass.
RECORD: Actual command, ordered test summary and work_result_locator
GATE: Only the named assertion failures are expected initially.
RECOVERY: Keep the actual error. Re-extract if protected files changed.
STOP: Timeout, crash, stderr, syntax error or signal is a real failure.
NEXT: Work on the single assessed file.

title: Implement only the assessed P01 file
EXACT ACTION: Use your prepared work to implement unit, integration and HTTP contracts with isolated fixtures, state follow-up, mutation attribution and cleanup. Preserve every other supplied file.
EXPECTED: Only this file differs; work may remain incomplete honestly.
GATE: Do not edit tests or application code to obtain green results.
RECOVERY: Compare your change boundary and restore unintended edits.
STOP: Do not request the whole assessed implementation from Gemini.

title: Check observable behaviour
EXACT ACTION:
Windows: .\VERIFY_WORK_RESULT.cmd
macOS/Linux: sh ./VERIFY_WORK_RESULT.sh
EXPECTED: All 10 named P01 tests pass after completed work, with exact package checks before and after execution.
GATE: A partial result remains incomplete.
RECOVERY: Read the first failing named contract and correct only the assessed file.
STOP: A green result does not qualify deployment or all possible defects.

title: Inspect edge and refusal cases
WHERE: Your P01 named results and assessed module
WHAT: Invalid input, unknown resource and method refusal
EXACT ACTION: Identify the invalid JSON/domain case, repeated completion and unknown or unsupported route. Point to the assertion, status and safe public error shape.
EXPECTED: A mechanism explanation tied to the observed case.
GATE: Response output alone cannot establish persisted state.
RECOVERY: Use source analysis if no run occurred and say so.
STOP: Do not dump raw request bodies, secrets or internal stacks.

title: Attribute all four seeded mutations
EXACT ACTION: For each mutation record the exact named assertion that kills it and the unit/integration/HTTP boundary. Keep the correct-adapter control.
EXPECTED: Four attributed failures and a correct-adapter pass when actually executed.
GATE: A copied killed true string is not current evidence.
RECOVERY: If a mutation survives, state which contract is missing.
STOP: Four samples do not prove exhaustive correctness.

title: Record repeat and cleanup
EXACT ACTION: Record the two run locators and whether named outcomes agree. Record activeServers and activeRuns after completion. The supplied tests check repeated execution; retain what you actually observed.
EXPECTED: Stable names and zero owned resources, or a documented failure.
RECORD: run_one_result, run_two_result, p01_repeatability and resource fields
GATE: A source-model result is not a loopback run.
RECOVERY: Stop the owned command and preserve failure evidence.
STOP: Do not claim the machine has zero unrelated processes.

title: Explain the persistence counterexample
WHERE: A disposable copy outside the assessed kit
EXACT ACTION: After a correct run, reason about removing the persisted follow-up assertion. If performing the experiment, use a separate copy, record what changed and restore it. Otherwise label the explanation SOURCE_ANALYSIS.
EXPECTED: An observed or reasoned distinction, explicitly classified.
GATE: The baseline kit remains protected.
RECOVERY: Restore the state-based assertion and rerun the correct-adapter control if executed.
STOP: Do not describe a thought experiment as an actual run.

title: Complete the ten-row P03 review
WHERE: Your own project inventory and evidence form
WHAT: Claim, source, state, owner, next action and limit
EXACT ACTION: Review identity, locked installation, audit, build, runtime/cleanup, logs, config/secrets, HTTP/errors/headers, deployment and exceptions. Include an owner and expiry or state no exception with a locator.
EXPECTED: Ten scoped rows with actual witnesses or explicit UNKNOWN.
GATE: Full P03 program implementation is optional. This table runs no commands.
RECOVERY: Narrow a claim and identify the next sufficient witness.
STOP: Do not run install, audit, external scan or deployment merely to make a field green.

title: Separate build from runtime
EXACT ACTION: Compare the build witness with a current start/health/shutdown witness. If the latter is missing, runtime is UNKNOWN. Note TLS and proxy evidence separately.
EXPECTED: The state follows evidence scope.
GATE: Required unknowns prevent a scoped PASS; known failures give fail.
RECOVERY: Record owner and next action without fabricating a result.
STOP: No production readiness certificate follows.

title: Demonstrate one behaviour
WHERE: Your own project or actual P01 run
EXACT ACTION: Choose one behaviour and show the minimum sufficient witness. Name its evidence class, version and limitation. Explain the mechanism rather than just showing green output.
EXPECTED: One bounded demonstration or an explicit NOT_EXECUTED state.
GATE: Do not expose credentials or unrelated personal data.
RECOVERY: Use a redacted excerpt or source analysis with a clear label.
STOP: Do not infer browser/deployment acceptance from a command log.

title: Defend a sampled claim
EXACT ACTION: Explain why the assertion belongs at its boundary, how it could miss a defect and which further witness would be sufficient. Record the actual question and your answer.
EXPECTED: A sampled explanation, not a universal assessment.
GATE: The 3/3/2/1/1 rubric remains unchanged.
RECOVERY: Say UNKNOWN when you cannot justify a claim.
STOP: Do not invent a teacher verdict.

title: Use Gemini as a bounded reviewer
WHERE: Gemini Web, only when the authorised course route is available
EXACT ACTION: Read the prompt, replace placeholders with one sanitised claim and the minimum evidence, send once and retain the relevant actual excerpt. Do not paste credentials, account exports or full private projects.
EXPECTED: One actual exchange or NOT_EXECUTED when unavailable.
GATE: Do not request the harness or full reviewer implementation.
RECOVERY: Use the labelled synthetic claim for local critique, leaving the live exchange NOT_EXECUTED.
STOP: Never attribute a synthetic response to Gemini.

title: Judge the Gemini response
EXACT ACTION: Test or reason about one claim with an independent witness. Choose ACCEPTED, REJECTED, PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED or UNKNOWN and explain the limit. Declare any AI-assisted changes accepted or rejected.
EXPECTED: A justified judgement with evidence class.
GATE: AI prose is not execution evidence.
RECOVERY: Reduce the claim until it can be checked.
STOP: No invented model reply or approval.

title: STOP at minute 60
EXACT ACTION: Stop programming and experiments. Save your work. Use STOP_SERVERS then STATUS_SERVERS; the kit owns no persistent server. For a separately started process use Ctrl+C in its own terminal and check its diagnostics.
EXPECTED: Content ends; only administration continues.
GATE: No new technical work in the 30-minute administration period.
RECOVERY: Retain incomplete work and assign the next action.
STOP: Do not kill unrelated applications.
NEXT: Back up and print a draft.

title: Back up the form and print a draft
EXACT ACTION: Click Export JSON backup and save outside the kit. Click Print draft. Use Ctrl+P on Windows/Linux or Cmd+P on macOS if needed, choose a PDF destination available in your browser and use the proposed filename.
EXPECTED: A real saved draft PDF and JSON, or a recorded save failure.
RECORD: PDF review state and actual filename
GATE: The browser print request does not prove saving.
RECOVERY: Use the DOCX form if HTML printing or storage fails. Keep all 64 field IDs.
STOP: Do not save files inside the integrity-checked kit.

title: Review and declare the actual PDF
EXACT ACTION: Read every page, long evidence row and final paragraph. Check code locators and UNKNOWN limits. Confirm the declaration only after review, set FINAL_REVIEWED_READY_NOT_SUBMITTED, print the reviewed form and inspect that newly saved PDF again.
EXPECTED: Legible complete PDF with truthful evidence and no unnecessary sensitive data.
GATE: Do not infer review from a checked field alone.
RECOVERY: Correct the form, re-export and review the saved result.
STOP: Clipping or missing paragraphs blocks submission.
NEXT: Submit only through the authorised Moodle route.

title: Record actual Moodle status and exit ticket
WHERE: The authorised S14 Assignment on online.ase.ro
EXACT ACTION: Use the course-provided S14 Assignment link. Attach one reviewed PDF, check the displayed file and complete the platform confirmation if required. Record the status actually shown. If the route is unavailable, retain READY_NOT_SUBMITTED and ask the course support route.
EXPECTED: One actual submission status or an explicit pending state.
GATE: No C14 Assignment, extra ZIP or hidden P02/P04 requirement.
RECOVERY: Retain the PDF and pending owner/action; do not invent a deadline or file limit.
STOP: An upload attempt is not verified receipt.
NEXT: End with one unresolved claim and the next sufficient witness.
